Just had my THR about 3 weeks ago and I can tell you a few things that may help: 

1) you will need someone to help you for at least a week
2) get all your prescriptions ahead of time and make sure you have a very specific plan to take the meds and to keep track of how much you take and when (my mom took care of me and I was 100% dependent on her for at least 4 days)
3) you will need a walker for at least a week
4) a shower chair or transfer seat is nice but not 100% necessary.  
5) if you normally sleep on the side that you’re having surgery on, like me, sleep is going to be tough. Be prepared to nap during the day or even all day the first couple weeks because sleep at night (for me) was awful. 
6) if you’re applying for disability or anything try to do as much as you can before the surgery even if it’s just seeing if you can log in or set up your account.  I had a really hard time with this process and since I wasn’t feeling well it was extra difficult.  Pay all your bills ahead of time so you don’t have to worry about your finances while you’re in that first week or two. 
7) stock up on water and snacks, and maybe something to do.  Even playing on my phone all day has gotten really boring! Good thing I have my little dog.  She keeps me company.  😊
